cranelift-jit 0.129.1, from crates.io (see .cargo_vcs_info.json).
License: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; original LICENSE retained.

Local changes in src/memory/system.rs:
- Release Windows VirtualAlloc regions with VirtualFree(MEM_RELEASE).
- Explicit free releases current allocations as well as finalized allocations,
  resets allocation state, and remains safe to call again.
- Implicit provider destruction preserves all published pointers, including
  writable/current allocations, as required by the existing provider contract.
- Windows tests verify release, reuse, empty state and implicit-drop lifetime.
